$schema_note: Tokens of the 'Nova' look (card 200; cards 202-213 build it). tokens.json (v1) stays the source of the Classic look and of the brands; this file only adds Nova and points to v1 where a value is shared. Units: px at 1920x1080 unless named; a 1280x720 UI uses every px value times 2/3 (layout.720p lists the ones that matter). Every heavy effect names its light fallback for the six render paths in 'paths'. Owner decisions of 2026-10-31 and the adjustments after the prototype (2026-11-01: Inter, the TV info line instead of the quotes, Continue Watching and picks in one band carousel, gold instead of red, the kids profile mark) rule (plan/200 and plan/214, last sections).
name: Nova
extends: design/tokens.json (version 1, unchanged: Classic look and brand table)

rules.contrast: WCAG AA: 4.5:1 for UI text (checked against the worst case: a pure white photo under the scrims), 3:1 for graphics and large text; brand logotypes exempt but legible
rules.focus: visible by scale and brightness (white surface, sheen), never by color alone
rules.animate_only: transform and opacity (web); Android: springs on position/scale/alpha, nothing re-rasterized per frame
rules.name_on_screen: Nova (never tvOS or any Apple mark)

paths.android13: Android 13+ and not Ui.LEGACY: RenderNode layers, AGSL glass (Shaders/Scene), cached shadows inside the layer
paths.android8_12: Android 9-12 with >= 3 GB (not LEGACY): RenderNode layers, no AGSL; glass = Backdrop's pre-blurred copy + tint
paths.legacy: Ui.LEGACY (Android 8-11, and 12/12L under 3 GB; the TCL target): no GPU layers, shadows from Shadows' nine-slice cache, solid glass, RGB_565 photos
paths.web: LG/Samsung, normal: rgba glass, static box-shadow on a separate element whose opacity animates
paths.web_flat: Samsung up to 2 GB (class flat): static shadows only, no shadow animation, layers only on what slides
paths.web_lite: Tizen 2.x and 1 GB LGs (class lite): no shadows, no transitions, no sheen, solid glass, w780 photos

font.$note: Nova uses Inter, the font the app already ships (owner, 2026-11-01): app/assets/fonts/InterVariable.ttf (OFL, OFL.txt beside it). Nothing downloaded. Classic keeps Inter too.

android.how: Ui.font(): Typeface.Builder(assets, fonts/InterVariable.ttf).setFontVariationSettings("'opsz' N, 'wght' W") (API 26, so Android 8 too); the system font only if the file is missing

instances.display_opsz32: Ui.displayMedium 500, Ui.displaySemibold 600 (clock, sheet titles, profile letters), Ui.light 300 (weather temperature)
instances.new: displayBold (opsz 32, wght 700) for the band title and the tile word: one more Typeface made once in Ui.init

android.cjk_devanagari: system font, as today (Inter has no such glyphs)

web.family: 'Inter', 'LG Smart UI', 'SamsungOne', 'Samsung Sans', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
web.face: @font-face { font-family: 'Inter'; src: url('fonts/InterVariable.ttf') format('truetype'); font-weight: 100 900; } as web/home.css already has (tools/webapp.py packs app/assets/fonts into fonts/)
web.old_chromium: Chrome < 62 (webOS 3 and 4, Tizen 3) has no variable fonts: it draws the default instance (400) and synthesizes bold for >= 600, as web/ does today
web.prototype: design/prototype/proto.css points @font-face at ../../app/assets/fonts/InterVariable.ttf (the repo's own file; web/ has no copy, the build copies it). Opened from file://, Chrome and Safari load it; Firefox refuses a file in a parent folder and lands on the fallback stack

type.$note: size px @1080 / weight / line-height. Every UI text >= 24 px.

band_title_long.when: title wider than max_width at 80 px on two lines

info_line.note: the TV info line next to the tabs (replaces the quotes in Nova)

tile_word.note: only when there is no logo: the name fitted to 80% of the tile width

sky.note: the screen below and around the band

ink_secondary.note: v1's #6E6E73 is 4.27:1 on its sky; Nova darkens it

band.$note: The band is a photo in both looks: its text is always white on scrims, day and night.

info.note: the TV info line, as tab_off

info_failed.note: failure and no-network text: full white plus a 20 px warning glyph (not by color alone)

focus_surface.note: focused tab, round button, band action pill, drawer key

color.day_night: Data.isNight / HomeView's night: dark from sunset to sunrise, as today (owner decision 4)

safe_area.note: 5% of 1920 and a bit more than 5% of 1080. Text and focusable items stay inside; photos and scrims are full-bleed

grid.note: the 5 tiles span the safe width exactly; hero text, row, drawer and All Apps align to x=96

row.note: left-aligned at x=96 (3 apps: three tiles on the left, no centering)

720p.$note: TCL 1 GB (UI drawn at 1280x720): every value x 2/3, rounded; bitmaps are built at these sizes, never at 1080p.

tile.radius_note: about 17% of the height, the proportion v1 keeps (22 on 126); 19 at 720p
tile.art: logo on the brand gradient (owner decision 2), the same on Google TV, LG and Samsung: gradient = tokens.json brand.<key>.tile (top, bottom), else the brand color darkened; logo lifted as today (HomeView.crispLogo, web lift())

logo_box.note: v1 is 0.76/0.58/0.085 on a 224x126 tile; Nova's tile is twice the area, so the logo grows from ~2.4k to ~7.1k px of ink without touching the edges

tile.no_logo: the app name in type.tile_word on the gradient; on light gradients (Prime, Globoplay, Spotify) a static 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.35) text shadow (lite: none; the word sits mid-gradient, 3.1-3.7:1)
tile.cache: rest and focus bitmaps at exactly 300x169 and 330x186 (720p: 200x113, 220x124); the same pair serves All Apps' cells, which use the same sizes. ~0.45 MB per app ARGB; LEGACY may use RGB_565 for opaque gradients
tile.night_rim: at night a 1 px inner rim, white 0.10 (lite: 1 px border white 0.14), so dark tiles (Netflix, YouTube, Claro tv+) keep their edge on the dark sky
tile.reorder: hold OK: scale 1.10 + lift 12 + wiggle 1.5 deg (v1 HomeView LIFT/WIGGLE), unchanged

fallback.android13: the two shadows as Shadows bitmaps (nine-slice, made once per size) drawn in the tile's RenderNode; focus crossfades rest->focus by alpha
fallback.legacy: Shadows bitmaps only (never BlurMaskFilter per frame); only the focused tile draws the focus shadow
fallback.web: rest: static box-shadow on .face; focus: a separate .shadow element with the focus box-shadow, opacity 0->1 (never a box-shadow transition)
fallback.web_flat: rest and focus shadows static; the focus shadow shows at once (no opacity transition)

sheen.gradient: white 0.20 at the top -> 0 at 55% of the height

parallax.direction: the last arrow pressed; springs back to 0
parallax.paths: on in android13, android8_12 and web (a translate of cached bitmaps); off in legacy, web_flat and web_lite

focus.dim_others: none: unfocused tiles stay at full opacity (no full-row repaint when the focus moves)

fallback.android13: sheen = LinearGradient made once per tile size (like watchSheen); rim stroke; parallax spring per zone
fallback.legacy: sheen and rim yes (cheap, cached shader), no parallax
fallback.web_lite: no sheen: focus = scale 1.10 + white 3 px ring (box-shadow none; an inner border on .face), brightness by the ring

content_order_for_focused_app: one carousel, one set of dots: first this app's Continue Watching (WatchNext; only when on in Home Settings; Android only), at most 3, most recent first; then the picks already downloaded whose service is this app (Recs.Pick.app / web SERVICES), at most 5, in Recs order (at most 8 dots)
the tab filters both: Explore = all, Movies = movie, Shows = tv (Continue items by their WatchNext type; an item with no type, a YouTube video, shows in every tab)
a pick that is also a Continue item (same TMDB id, else the same title) shows once, as Continue
the action pill says 'Continuar' on Continue items and 'Assistir' on picks; Continue items also show the progress bar
neither: the app's art: the brand gradient full-bleed + the lifted logo large, and the app name as the title (the band takes no focus)
band.no_tmdb_key: no picks: Continue Watching, else the app's art. The tabs are hidden (nothing to filter)
band.kids_profile: on a profile marked kids, the picks come from the kids list (profile.kids); Continue Watching is unchanged (owner, 2026-11-01)
band.no_favorites: general picks (card 206); without picks, one of your photos (Photos), else the aurora (Scene)
band.follow_note: as BG_FOLLOW_MS: nothing is decoded until the focus rests 500 ms on a tile; a newer request cancels the older (generation)
band.auto_advance: none (no decode without a key press)

top.unit: px from the top, black alpha
top.why: clock and tips >= 5.4:1 on a white photo

left.why: title >= 6.2:1 up to x=1056 on a white photo

art_from_app.logo: lifted logo, height up to 240, right half, centered at x=1340 y=360; only on android/web; the prototype draws the name in type instead

images.size: TMDB w1280 (already fetched today; no new endpoint, no new domain)
images.decode: LOADER thread, Bitmap.prepareToDraw() before the swap
images.app_art: no photo: gradient shader + one logo bitmap (<= 640x240, ~0.6 MB), kept for the current and the previous app only

fallback.android13: sharp photo + scrim shaders (made once per size) + crossfade by alpha
fallback.legacy: same, RGB_565; the scrims are one combined bitmap-free LinearGradient pair; crossfade 420 ms
fallback.web: two stacked divs with background-image, opacity crossfade; scrims are static linear-gradient divs

tabs.role: a quiet filter of the band (owner decision 5): Explore / Movies / Shows
tabs.place: top bar, left, at x=96 over the band's top scrim
tabs.selected: white, weight 600, capsule white 0.16 (not by color alone: weight + capsule)
tabs.focused: white surface, ink #1D1D1F, scale 1.06, pill_focus shadow
tabs.behavior: focusing a tab selects it (as today); the band re-filters once the focus rests follow_delay_ms (running past the tabs decodes nothing); Down before that applies it at once

order_right_to_left: Top Buttons extras and Recent Apps (HomeApps.MAX_TOP)
Now Playing capsule (when allowed and playing)
tv_info line (left, right after the tabs; replaces the quotes in Nova)
top_bar.button: 64 px circle, glass.thin, white symbol 28 px; focused: white surface, dark symbol, scale 1.12, tip below (type.button_tip) over the top scrim
top_bar.clock: type.clock, white, right edge at 1824, centered on the bar
top_bar.focus_order: one line, left to right, no wrap: tabs (when there is a TMDB key) -> speed -> extras -> Live TV -> Inputs -> Settings -> Profile; the clock and the rest of the info line take no focus

tv_info.$note: Owner, 2026-11-01: quotes leave Nova (they stay in Classic when on); in their place, next to the tabs, a line about the TV: city · temperature · resolution · refresh · last speed test and when. Example: 'São Paulo · 24 °C · 4K · 60 Hz · ↓ 230 Mbps · há 2 h'.

parts.city: Config/Place city (config.properties or the time zone in --generic); never GPS or IP geolocation
parts.temperature: the forecast the app already fetches (HomeData / web Data), rounded, with its unit ('{t} °C'; °F when the build's temperature setting says F, as the weather panel); hidden until the first forecast arrives
parts.resolution: Android: Display.getMode() physical size -> 8K / 4K / 1080p / 720p, refresh rounded ('60 Hz'; 59.94 -> 60). Web: approximate: LG getSystemInfo UHD -> 4K else 1080p, Samsung tizen.systeminfo DISPLAY; no Hz on the web (the browser can't read the panel's)
parts.speed: the last speed test (download only, the arrow ↓): Mbps with no decimals from 10 up, one decimal below 10 ('8,4 Mbps'), Gbps with one decimal from 1000 ('1,2 Gbps'), and how long ago ('agora', 'há 5 min', 'há 2 h', 'ontem', 'há 3 dias'). Per TV, not per profile

tv_info.order_of_dropping: when the line doesn't fit before the leftmost top item (32 px gap), drop in this order: Hz, resolution, temperature, city; the speed item always stays (it has focus)

speed_item.rest: type.info_line, white 0.78, no surface, inside a 56 px capsule (padding 20) so focus has room
speed_item.focus: white surface, ink #1D1D1F, scale 1.06, pill_focus shadow (as a tab)

states.testing: 'Testando… ' + a 120x4 bar under the text (track white 0.30, fill white; on focus ink 0.25/ink) that fills over ~10 s; fill by scaleX, updated 4 times a second (not every frame)
states.failed: warning glyph + 'Teste falhou' (white 1.0), until the focus leaves the item; then back to the last result or 'Testar velocidade'. The old result is kept
states.offline: warning glyph + 'Sem internet' while the TV has no network (Android: ConnectivityManager default network; web: navigator.onLine false and the last fetch failing); the old result is hidden, not deleted

speed_item.ok: result / never / failed: starts the test. testing: nothing. offline: a toast 'Sem conexão com a internet' (no test)
speed_item.test: only when OK is pressed on this item, never by itself, never on a timer (owner). Cloudflare speed.cloudflare.com (no key; approved 2026-11-01, card 215 adds it to CLAUDE.md and README): a few tiny requests for latency, then downloads of growing size for up to 10 s or 200 MB, whichever comes first; the result is the median throughput of the larger downloads. Background thread (Android: not the UI thread; nothing escapes it, :home's watchdog counts crashes); web: XHR, no Worker needed
speed_item.cancel: leaving the home screen (an app opens, onPause / visibilitychange) cancels it and keeps the old result; Back or arrows don't cancel (the line keeps updating while the focus is elsewhere)

talkback.result: Velocidade da internet: {n} megabits, testada {ago}. OK para testar de novo
talkback.never: Velocidade da internet: ainda não testada. OK para testar
talkback.testing: Testando a velocidade da internet (announced once at start); at the end: 'Velocidade da internet: {n} megabits'
talkback.failed: O teste de velocidade falhou. OK para tentar de novo

fallback.android13: text drawn on the bar's layer; the bar is a rect
fallback.legacy: same; only the item's rect is invalidated while testing

tv_info.no_network_at_all: city and resolution stay (they are local); the temperature shows the last forecast while the app keeps it, else it's dropped; the speed item says 'Sem internet'

drawer.open: Down on the row: home slides up by layout.drawer.shift, band/hero/top fade to 0, the row stays as context at y=260
drawer.keys: glass.regular, 24 px label, symbol 36 px; focused: white surface, scale 1.07, key_focus shadow
drawer.panels: weather only, on glass.regular, the full safe width (1728), with up to 10 hours (Snapshot cache in LEGACY, as today). The quotes leave Nova (owner, 2026-11-01); Classic keeps them when on
groups: Shortcuts (All Apps, Home Settings, TV Settings, Home Assistant tiles)

all_apps.sheet: glass.thick full screen; 5 columns of 300x169 on the same grid as the row; labels 24 px under each tile
all_apps.focus: as tile (scale 1.10, shadow, sheen); the label turns white
all_apps.scroll: the grid slides by rows to keep the focused row in rows 1-3 (spring row_scroll)

profile.$note: Meu TV OS profiles (card 214): local, one per person in the house; a name, a color and its initial. Not a Google account; no photos, emoji or third-party avatars. Each profile has its own favorites row and band preferences.
profile.initial: first letter of the name, uppercased (locale-aware: Ui.locale()); two profiles may share it, their color and name tell them apart

palette.$note: White initial on each >= 4.5:1 (also the focused button: the color on white, the same pair). 'sheet' = graphic contrast on glass.thick's darkest lite tint #141418 (>= 3:1). New profiles take the first color not in use, in this order.

gold.note: replaces red #C62839 (too close to pink, owner 2026-11-01); the farthest of the candidates from the other 7 (CIELAB dE >= 46; the closest pair left is pink/blue-purple at ~21-23)

button.place: top bar, the last round button: right of Settings, 32 px left of the clock (button_gap 20 to the others)
button.disk: profile color, inner rim 1 px white 0.22
button.focus: as every round button: white surface, scale 1.12, the name as the tip (type.button_tip), centered under it (the clock keeps it inside the safe area); the initial turns the profile color

fallback.android13: disk + text drawn on the bar's layer

sheet.glass: glass.thick, full screen, what is under fades to 0 (as all_apps)
sheet.line: one centered line: the profiles, then Add while fewer than 6 (7 items = 1592 px, inside the 1728 safe width)
sheet.active_badge: 52 px white disk with a dark check, at the circle's lower right (not by color alone)
sheet.focus: circle scale 1.10, shadow 0 26 44 rgba(0,0,0,0.55), white ring 6 px, 6 px off the disk (a border, so it stays in lite); the name turns white
sheet.add: glass disk white 0.12 with a 72 px plus; focused: white surface, dark plus, scale 1.10 (no ring)

fallback.legacy: solid sheet, Shadows bitmap for the focused circle only
fallback.web_lite: no shadow, no transitions; ring and badge stay; Add's disk #2A2A2D

kids.$note: A profile can be marked kids (owner, 2026-11-01; card 214c). Its band's picks are filtered by age: TMDB discover with certification_country=BR and certification.lte=10 (L or 10), plus the Animation and Family genres; Continue Watching unchanged. No app blocking, no PIN. Same endpoint (no new network); its own cache, fetched in the background, so a profile switch stays <= 300 ms. Until that list arrives, the band shows Continue Watching or the app's art, never the general picks
kids.badge: a small white disk with a dark bear-head glyph (three filled circles, drawn here, no third-party art), at the circle's upper right (the active badge stays at the lower right): sheet 44 px (glyph 26), top bar button 22 px (glyph 14) at the disk's lower right with a 2 px ring in the bar's dark tint; never by color alone, and the TalkBack text says it
kids.talkback: {name}, perfil infantil (and '{name}, perfil ativo, perfil infantil' when active); the button: 'Perfil: {name}, infantil'
kids.editor: Home Settings > Profiles > <profile> > 'Perfil infantil' (on/off), with the line 'Sugestões só com classificação livre e até 10 anos. Não bloqueia apps.'

profile.single_profile: with only Principal: the button shows (Nova; Classic when on in Top Buttons) and 'Who's watching?' is not asked at a full start; it's asked from 2 profiles on (owner, 2026-11-01)
profile.new_profile: starts with a copy of the current profile's row (card 214 decision 3) and the first free palette color
profile.after_full_start: with 2 or more profiles, the sheet always shows after a full start of the TV (never on a wake from standby; Free My TV mode only; web: cold start), focus on the last profile, no timeout, Back keeps the last profile; exception: At power-on = Live TV waits 10 s and goes on with the last profile (card 214 decision 6)
profile.classic: Home Settings > Profiles (first row, 40 px disk + name; OK opens the same sheet) and an optional Profile button in Top Buttons, off by default, sized and focused as Classic's own top buttons (card 214 decision 5)
profile.motion: sheet opens and closes as motion.sheet; focus as motion.focus; the row of the new profile appears at once under the closing sheet (no extra animation)

thin.use: round buttons at rest, Now Playing capsule, tip capsule if needed (over the band)
thin.android13: AGSL glass of Scene, blur 24, tint above
thin.android8_12: solid tint rgba(28,28,30,0.55) (too small to be worth a Backdrop copy)

regular.use: drawer keys and panels, Now Playing panel
regular.android13: AGSL glass over the sky, tint above
regular.android8_12: Backdrop's pre-blurred 480x270 copy stretched in the panel + tint
regular.legacy: solid: day #F7F7F9, night #1F1F23 (Snapshot for weather and quotes)
regular.web: day linear-gradient(rgba(255,255,255,0.86), rgba(255,255,255,0.66)); night linear-gradient(rgba(38,38,42,0.78), rgba(17,17,19,0.64))

thick.use: All Apps, Home Settings sheets, the OK-held menu, toasts
thick.tint: rgba(22,22,26,0.88) (dark day and night, as today's sheets)
thick.web: full-screen sheets (All Apps): rgba(12,12,15,0.94) and what is under fades to opacity 0 (no blur, so nothing may show through); boxes (Settings): linear-gradient(rgba(34,36,44,0.96), rgba(18,20,26,0.97)) as today

motion.$note: Android: Spring(response s, damping) as Spring.java; CSS: the transition that matches it. lite = 0 ms everywhere.

day_night.how: sky layers crossfade by opacity; text colors switch at once (no color transitions)

budget.pss_target_card: <= +8 MB per card (card 201 rule); Nova total <= 130 MB on the TCL (owner decision 9)
budget.web_layers: will-change only on the focused tile and on what slides (row, drawer); never on every tile

brand_nova.$note: Only what Nova adds to tokens.json brand: the word color used when there is no logo (and in design/prototype), and Spotify's gradient, which v1 lacks (it comes from web/home.js SHELF). Brand colors, logo modes and Android TILE_STYLE stay in v1.

spotify.source: web/home.js SHELF and HomeApps.SHELF color 1DB954; no Android TILE_STYLE today

contrast_checked.$note: WCAG 2 ratios computed by script (sRGB relative luminance); 'worst' = a pure white photo under the scrims.
contrast_checked.brand_words: Netflix red 4.1-4.4, Claro red 3.7, Prime white 2.6 (top) - 5.3 (bottom), 3.65 mid; Globoplay 2.4-3.6, 3.07 mid; Spotify 2.6-5.4, 3.66 mid; the rest >= 6.9. Logotypes are exempt; the fallback word sits mid-tile (>= 3:1 large text) with the static shadow
